node.title: Official C1 odd-moment matrix is 256 invertible blocks D_a F; exact iid block marginals coupled by one companion orbit
node.statement: On every official-shape C1 level (N=256L, omega of exact order 512L), writing y=a+256b and theta=omega^256 (exact order 2L), the a-th L-column block of the odd-moment matrix is A_a=D_a F with D_a=diag(omega^((2j+1)a)) and F the Vandermonde matrix on the L distinct odd powers of theta (the roots of X^L+1). All 256 blocks are bases of F_q^L. Consequences: the Boolean subset-sum distribution is the 256-fold convolution of uniform measures on full-size 2^L parallelepipeds A_a{0,1}^L; each block Fourier vector C_a=A_a^T lambda is EXACTLY uniform (exact iid L-coordinate block marginals); and D_a=D_1^a gives C_a=M^a C_0 with M=F^T D_1 F^(-T), so all cross-block spectral dependence rides one deterministic 256-step linear orbit. Not claimed: joint independence, any mixing/expansion property of M, any bound on E-1, C1-ZERO/SWIF-4, any role of the v_2(q-1)>=41 gate, non-official aspects, or either Prize result. Provenance: Brief-1 Pro dossier (notes/pro_briefs_20260801/responses/), audited and replayed 2026-08-01.
